name: au.com.trip-planner/camping-australia
title: Camping Australia
description: Search campsites, caravan parks and free camps in Australia, the US, Canada, NZ, Argentina, Chile.

tools.name: find_nearest_toilets
tools.description: Find the public toilets nearest to a set of coordinates, using data from the National Public Toilet Map. Useful for finding the closest toilet, the closest accessible toilet or the nearest RV dump point. Returns toilets sorted by distance, each with name, address, distance, opening hours, facilities (wheelchair access, baby change, RV dump point, showers, drinking water and more) and a directions link. If none fall inside radius_km, the closest ones are still returned.

radius_km.description: Search radius in km (default 15). If none are within radius, the closest are returned anyway.

tools.name: search_campsites
tools.description:
Search campsites, caravan parks, free camps and other accommodation by place name, region, state, map coordinates, listing type and features. Returns matching listings with name, location, rating, features and images.

Coverage: Australia (the default), the United States (federal, BLM and national-forest campgrounds plus free camping), Canada, New Zealand, Argentina and Chile. The country parameter selects one country per search; results from different countries are not mixed.

Feature filtering: the features array takes exact feature names, and only listings that have every listed feature are returned. Common names:
Amenities: Toilets, Showers, Hot Showers, Drinking Water, Power, WiFi Internet, Laundromat, Dump Point, Camp Kitchen
Activities: Fishing Spot, Beach Fishing, Swimming, Walking, Boating, Boat Ramp, Bird Watching
Accommodation: Caravans, Caravan Park, Tent Site, Campground, Cabins, Free Camping, Showground
Facilities: BBQ, Fire Place, Shade, Picnic Tables, Children's Play Facility, Swimming Pool
Rules: Pets Welcome, No Pets, Accessible, Camping Fee, Mobile Phone Coverage
Pet-friendly listings carry 'Pets Welcome'; listings tagged 'No Pets' do not allow pets. get_features returns the complete list.

country.description: Country to search: 'AU' (Australia, the default), 'US' (United States), 'CA' (Canada), 'NZ' (New Zealand), 'AR' (Argentina) or 'CL' (Chile). Each search covers one country.

entity_type.description:
Restrict results to one listing type:
- 'free_camping': free bush camps and rest areas with overnight stays
- 'caravan_park': caravan parks with powered/unpowered sites
- 'campground': managed campgrounds (national parks etc.)
- 'accom': accommodation (cabins, lodges, holiday parks)
- 'campsite': individual campsites
- 'tours': tours and activities
- 'poi': points of interest, day-use areas, lookouts and picnic spots (no overnight camping)
Omit to search all types.

features.description: Exact feature names a listing has to have, e.g. ['Pets Welcome', 'Toilets', 'Swimming Pool']. A listing is returned only if it has all of them. get_features lists the valid names.

near_latitude.description: Latitude for proximity search. AU: -33.8688 Sydney. US: 38.5733 Moab, 37.8651 Yosemite Valley. CA: 51.1784 Banff, 49.2827 Vancouver. NZ: -45.0312 Queenstown, -38.1368 Rotorua, -43.5321 Christchurch, -36.8485 Auckland. AR: -41.13 Bariloche, -32.89 Mendoza, -50.34 El Calafate. CL: -41.32 Puerto Varas, -39.27 Pucón, -51.73 Puerto Natales / Torres del Paine. Set 'country' to match.

near_longitude.description: Longitude for proximity search. AU: 151.2093 Sydney. US: -109.5498 Moab, -119.5383 Yosemite Valley. CA: -115.5708 Banff, -123.1207 Vancouver. NZ: 168.6626 Queenstown, 176.2497 Rotorua, 172.6362 Christchurch, 174.7633 Auckland. AR: -71.31 Bariloche, -68.84 Mendoza, -72.28 El Calafate. CL: -72.99 Puerto Varas, -71.98 Pucón, -72.51 Puerto Natales / Torres del Paine. Set 'country' to match.

query.description: Free-text campsite name or place (e.g. 'Byron Bay', 'Moab', 'Banff', 'Queenstown', 'Bariloche', 'Torres del Paine', 'Central Coast'). Facility requirements are matched by the features parameter, not here.

radius_km.description: Search radius in kilometres (default 50, use 100-150 for broader search)

region.description: Region name to search within (e.g. 'South Coast', 'Blue Mountains')

state.description: Australian state or territory abbreviation (e.g. 'NSW', 'VIC', 'QLD'). Applies to Australian searches only; for other countries use query or near_latitude/near_longitude.

tools.name: get_campsite_details
tools.description: Get the full record for one campsite or accommodation listing by its entity_id (from search_campsites results). Returns the description, all features and amenities, address, photos, rating, accommodation types offered and booking information. Inactive listings are not returned.

entity_id.description: The unique entity ID of the campsite

tools.name: get_regions
tools.description: List camping and accommodation regions with the number of listings in each, optionally filtered by state. Useful for browsing by area when there is no specific destination yet.

tools.name: get_features
tools.description: List every feature and amenity a campsite listing can have, optionally filtered by category. These are the exact names search_campsites accepts in its features filter.

tools.name: get_accommodation_types
tools.description: List the accommodation types offered at one listing (for example powered sites, unpowered sites, cabins or rooms), by entity_id from search_campsites. Returns pricing, capacity, amenities and vehicle access for each type.

entity_id.description: The entity ID to get accommodation types for

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search camping gear, outdoor products and accessories sold in the Camping Australia store, by keyword and/or product category. Returns matching products with name, brand, price, image and stock details.

product_type.description: Product category to filter by (e.g. 'Tents', 'Outdoor Recreation > Fishing', 'Caravan Accessories')

tools.name: recommend_gear
tools.description: Suggest products from the Camping Australia store suited to one campsite, based on its features and type: for example fishing gear for a campsite with fishing, or recovery equipment for one with 4WD-only access. Takes the campsite's entity_id from search_campsites.

entity_id.description: The campsite entity ID to recommend gear for

tools.name: get_weather_forecast
tools.description:
Get a daily weather forecast for a campsite or a pair of coordinates. Provide either campsite_name (a full or partial campsite name, resolved to that campsite's stored coordinates) or latitude and longitude.

Returns up to 14 days from the primary forecast provider, or about 10 days when the backup provider answers; the forecast_days field states how many days are included. Each day has max/min temperature, rain chance, rainfall amount, maximum wind speed, UV index, minimum humidity and a condition description, plus sunrise and sunset where available.

campsite_name.description: Full or partial campsite name (e.g. 'Byron Bay', 'Big4 Morisset'). The first matching campsite's stored coordinates are used.

latitude.description: Latitude of the location (e.g. -33.8688 for Sydney)

longitude.description: Longitude of the location (e.g. 151.2093 for Sydney)

tools.name: bk_search_operators
tools.description: Requires sign-in. Find accommodation operators near a set of coordinates that can be booked in real time, with live inventory from our booking partner. This differs from search_campsites, which searches the full Camping Australia directory, including places that cannot be booked online. Returns each operator's operator_id, name, town, state, distance and from-price; operator_id is the input to bk_operator_availability and bk_cart_add.

tools.name: bk_operator_availability
tools.description: Requires sign-in. Get live products, prices and availability at one bookable operator for specific dates and party size. operator_id comes from bk_search_operators; check_in and check_out are YYYY-MM-DD dates. Returns bookable products with product_id, price, max_guests and an available flag (or, for some caravan parks, an availability grid). The product_id and price are the inputs to bk_cart_add.

tools.name: bk_cart_add
tools.description:
Requires sign-in and the booking:cart permission. Add a product to the live booking cart, or answer a question the park asks while adding it.
- First add: omit session_key to open a new cart, and pass operator_id, product_id, check_in, check_out, adults, children and quoted_price (the price from bk_operator_availability).
- The response status is 'added' when the item is in the cart, or 'question_pending' with one question from the park and a pending_token. Answering means calling again with the same session_key, the pending_token and answer={field_id, value}; this repeats until the status is 'added'.
Each response carries the session_key that identifies the cart in later cart calls.

answer.description: Answer to the pending booking question

operator_id.description: Operator id from bk_search_operators (for a new product add)

pending_token.description: Token from a prior 'question_pending' response (when answering a booking question)

quoted_price.description: The price quoted by bk_operator_availability for this product

session_key.description: Cart session key from a prior cart call. Omit on the very first add to open a new cart.

tools.name: bk_cart_checkout
tools.description:
Requires sign-in and the booking:checkout permission. Finalise the live booking cart in two steps:
1. Without confirm, it returns the booking summary (property, dates, guests) and total price, with no payment link.
2. With confirm=true, it returns a single link to the park's secure payment page covering the whole cart. The traveller pays on that page; this connector never takes payment.
confirm=true is intended for after the traveller has reviewed the summary and agreed to proceed. The booking stays pending until payment is completed on the payment page. The cart needs no pending questions and a lead guest set with bk_cart_guest.

confirm.description: true returns the secure payment link; intended for after the traveller has reviewed the summary and total and agreed to proceed. Omitted or false returns only the summary and total.

tools.name: bk_cart_guest
tools.description: Requires sign-in and the booking:cart permission. Set the lead guest's contact details on the live booking cart; a name and email are needed before checkout. For a signed-in customer, any of first_name, surname and email left out are filled from their Camping Australia account, and explicit values override the account details. Returns the updated cart.

tools.name: bk_cart_promo
tools.description: Requires sign-in and the booking:cart permission. Apply a promo or discount code to the live booking cart, or remove one with remove=true. A code applied before bk_cart_checkout is reflected in the checkout total. Returns the updated cart.

remove.description: True to remove the code instead of applying it

tools.name: bk_search_content
tools.description: Requires sign-in. Search curated tourism content (attractions, things to do, local experiences and events) from our booking partner, for questions such as what's on near a place. This content is not part of the campsite directory; accommodation is searched with bk_search_operators. Returns the matching content.

query.description: What to search for (e.g. 'things to do near Jervis Bay')

tools.name: search_campervans
tools.description: Search live campervan and motorhome hire availability and prices for an Australian pickup city and travel dates (pickup_date and dropoff_date in YYYY-MM-DD format). This is vehicle rental; search_campsites finds places to stay. Returns matching vehicles with brand, name, category, sleeps and seats, 4WD, nightly and total price in AUD, and a booking_url where the hire is completed on the rental partner's website. Australia only.

dropoff_date.description: Drop-off date, YYYY-MM-DD. Must be after pickup_date.

tools.name: get_campervan_booking_link
tools.description: Get a link for completing a campervan or motorhome hire for an Australian pickup city and dates, without running a search first. The hire is booked and paid on the rental partner's website; this connector takes no payment. Returns a single booking_url. Australia only.
